	Evaluate Mode = "eval"

func (m observedModel) Stream(ctx context.Context, r abi.ModelRequest, emit func(wire.StreamChunk) error) error

func (s *Service) Cancel(ctx context.Context) error

func (s *Service) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (s *Service) Plan(request Request) (Report, error)

func (s *Service) Snapshot() Snapshot

func (s *Service) Start(request Request) error

func (s *Service) Targets() []eval.Target

func DefaultDataset() Dataset

func NewService(routes []Route) (*Service, error)

func NewServiceWithSource(routes []Route, source TargetSource) (*Service, error)

func RunCLI(ctx context.Context, args []string, input io.Reader, stdout, stderr io.Writer) error

type Dataset struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Version string `json:"version"`
	Tasks   []Task `json:"tasks"`
}

type Mode string

type Report struct {
	Version           int           `json:"version"`
	Kind              Mode          `json:"kind"`
	DatasetID         string        `json:"dataset_id,omitempty"`
	DatasetVersion    string        `json:"dataset_version,omitempty"`
	DatasetSHA256     string        `json:"dataset_sha256,omitempty"`
	Scores            []Score       `json:"scores,omitempty"`
	Mode              string        `json:"mode"`
	TotalPlannedCalls int           `json:"total_planned_calls"`
	Reports           []eval.Report `json:"reports"`
}

type Request struct {
	Mode            Mode     `json:"mode"`
	Targets         []string `json:"targets"`
	ToolNames       []string `json:"tool_names,omitempty"`
	Dataset         *Dataset `json:"dataset,omitempty"`
	Repeats         int      `json:"repeats"`
	MaxCalls        int      `json:"max_calls"`
	TimeoutMS       int      `json:"timeout_ms"`
	MaxOutputTokens uint32   `json:"max_output_tokens"`
}

type Route struct {
	ID       string
	Protocol provider.Kind
	Provider provider.Config
}

type Score struct {
	TargetID             string   `json:"target_id"`
	GradedTrials         int      `json:"graded_trials"`
	ExecutionErrors      int      `json:"execution_errors"`
	WeightedScore        *float64 `json:"weighted_score_percent,omitempty"`
	ConsistentTaskPasses int      `json:"consistent_task_passes"`
	TotalTasks           int      `json:"total_tasks"`
	PlannedCalls         int      `json:"planned_calls"`
	AttemptedCalls       int      `json:"attempted_calls"`
	MeanDurationMS       *float64 `json:"mean_duration_ms,omitempty"`
	MeanFirstOutputMS    *float64 `json:"mean_first_output_ms,omitempty"`
	UsageReportedTrials  int      `json:"usage_reported_trials"`
}

type Service struct {
}

type Snapshot struct {
	ID           uint64 `json:"id"`
	State        string `json:"state"`
	StartedCalls int    `json:"started_calls"`
	Report       Report `json:"report"`
}

type TargetSource interface {
	Targets() []eval.Target
	Resolve(context.Context, []eval.Target) ([]Route, error)
}

type Task struct {
	ID           string          `json:"id"`
	Prompt       string          `json:"prompt"`
	ExpectedText *string         `json:"expected_text,omitempty"`
	ExpectedJSON json.RawMessage `json:"expected_json,omitempty"`
	Weight       int             `json:"weight"`
}
